headline: Executive session on Belter v. City of Burlington litigation, plus airport construction, finances, and marketing updates.
summary: The commission will discuss pending litigation in Belter v. City of Burlington in executive session, review a reorganization, and receive updates on construction, sound insulation, finances, and marketing. The Director's Report and follow-up items on artificial intelligence and jet fuel taxes will also be covered.
items: Executive session on Belter v. City of Burlington litigation
Residential Sound Insulation Program updates, L. Lackey
Innovation and Marketing Quarterly updates, J. Bartley
Follow up on Jet Fuel Taxes
location: Third Floor Conference Room at the Airport / Zoom

Recommended Action 1. Move to make a specific finding that premature general public knowledge of the 
matter of Belter v. City of Burlington would clearly place the City and Airport at a 
substantial disadvantage; 
2. Based upon that finding, move to enter executive session pursuant to 1 VSA 
313(a)(1)(E)&(F) to discuss pending civil litigation to which the City and Airport are 
parties and to receive confidential attorney-client communications
